 Early Black Friday 2026 deals: See holiday gift guides from Amazon, The Home Depot, Nordstrom, Ulta, and more
 Mashable Follow Lauren Allain Updated Tue, October 20, 2026 at 3:44 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Updated Tue, October 20, 2026 at 3:44 PM UTC the ninja crispi air fryer, drybar hair dryer, amazon holiday toy guide, puleo christmas tree, and apple airpods in a cluster on a blue background - Ninja / Drybar / Amazon / Puleo / Apple / Mashable Photo Composite It's not often walk to the mailbox and find something inside we're excited about. Amidst the bills and junk mail, top brands launch their Black Friday gift guides , and some might be landing in your mailbox.
 The official Black Friday date is Nov. 27 this year, the day after Thanksgiving. But you don't need to wait for deals to drop then. Amazon, The Home Depot, and Target all have Black Friday sales underway right now.
 Browsing the deals is half the fun of shopping during Black Friday. And if you're trending toward Analog life, you can request a free physical copy of some gift guides including Amazon's Holiday Kids Gift Book 2026 . But you have plenty of other browsing to do, too.
 Advertisement Advertisement The Home Depot Black Friday Gift Guide is packed with cordless power tools, holiday decor, and gifts for the gardener in your life. Walmart has conveniently broken down the top 100 gifts including Apple Airpods Pro 3 and the Nintendo Switch 2.
 Ulta's Black Friday Gift Guide is the perfect cheat-sheet for buying beauty gifts for your friends, and Costco has excellent deals on artificial Christmas trees and laptops if you're a member. Nordstrom is a great place to grab stocking stuffers and gifts are already up to 40% off.
 If toys are on your shopping list, be sure to peek the Target Black Friday Gift Guide, as well as the Meijer Toy Book and the Fleet Farm's Toyland which opened earlier in October. Remember if you're shopping for tech deals, sometimes Target offers better discounts than Amazon's Black Friday offerings.
 Below, we've rounded up some of our favorite early Black Friday deals from the top gift guides.
 Best Walmart deal
 Apple Airpods Pro 3
 Get Deal↗ Apple Airpods Pro 3 
 Why we like it
 A classic sale on some of the best Airpods , you can already snag them for $199 at Walmart. The Airpods Pro 3 come with great sound, exceptional noise cancellation, good battery life, and even a heart-rate monitor. On Mashable's list of the best earbuds , the Airpods Pro 3 earn the top spot as the best option for Apple users. While the $199 sale price isn't unheard of, they do tend to sell out during busy sale seasons, so shop early to avoid the stress.
 Best Amazon deal
 Hisense 85-inch E6 Hi-QLED 4K TV
 Get Deal↗ 
 Why we like it
 The holidays are a time for relaxing and what better to do so than with a massive TV to watch romantic Christmas movies? The giant 85-inch Hisense E6 QLED 4K TV is already on sale at Amazon well before Black Friday and it's under $800. Plus, it's the perfect early holiday gift for anyone who's recently moved into a bigger place.
 Best Target deal
 Tineco Go HammerHead Cordless Wet/Dry Mop & Vacuum
 Get Deal↗ Tineco Go HammerHead Cordless Wet/Dry Mop & Vacuum 
 Why we like it
 No one likes to spend the holidays cleaning the house. Keep the task of cleaning the floors as quick and painless as possible with the Tineco Go HammerHead Cordless Mop and Vacuum . All in one go, you'll be able to vacuum and mop, and maneuvering is made easy thanks to Tineco's swivel steering.
 Best Ulta deal
 Conair InfinitiPRO DigitalAIRE Drying Wand
 Get Deal↗ Conair InfinitiPRO DigitalAIRE Drying Wand 
 Why we like it
 Black Friday sales is one of the best times of the year to shop for beauty deals . Instead of paying big time for a Dyson hair dryer, Ulta has great deals in store on Conair beauty tech including the InfintiPro Drying Wand , which is on sale for under $100.
 Advertisement Advertisement Aiming for a faster drying experience, the Conair detangles, smooths, and adds volume. It'll be a staple for getting ready for holiday parties this season.
 Download the Ulta app and you'll be in line for special daily savings you won't find online. Today's mobile app deals include saving 20% on CeraVe products, makeup from Smashbox, and free gifts with purchase.
 Best Home Depot deal
 Milwaukee M18 18-Volt Lithium-Ion Cordless Combo Kit
 Get Deal↗ Milwaukee M18 18-Volt Lithium-Ion Cordless Combo Kit 
 Why we like it
 With eight cordless power tools and two batteries, the Milwaukee M18 18-Volt Lithium-Ion Cordless Combo Kit is the ultimate gift for anyone in your life who could use a tool upgrade. Winter is the perfect time for garage and home renovation projects, so this deal couldn't come at a better time.
